claim: Founder ruling RECEIPTS-W56 (2026-10-02, verbatim option "Price as printed (Recommended)"): POST /procurement/orders/:id/verify-receipt takes the invoice price AS PRINTED with an optional invoicePriceUom + invoicePricePackSize pair in ADR 0119's price_uom vocabulary (absent = per bottle, unchanged for old apps). computeMatch reads it once (readInvoicePrice, reusing resolveStatedPriceUnit; keg/litre refused with a 400) and compares the agreed per-bottle price scaled to the invoice's pack against the printed figure to the cent, so a ten-cent case variance is not lost to per-bottle rounding. Behaviour proven by invoice-match.spec.ts ('the invoice price in its printed unit') and verify-receipt.spec.ts ('the invoice price is read in the unit it is printed in'), mutation-checked on fix/receive-price-as-printed.
verify: grep -qF 'invoicePriceUom?: string;' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/dto/procurement.dto.ts && grep -qF 'export function readInvoicePrice(' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/invoice-match.ts && grep -qF 'priceEquals(agreedInInvoiceUnit as number, invoicePrice.asPrinted)' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/invoice-match.ts && grep -qF 'invoicePriceUom: body.invoicePriceUom ?? null,' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/procurement.service.ts

claim: verifyReceipt's own-paper sighting (vendor_price_observations, ADR 0117 class A) is labelled with the unit the invoice PRINTS ITS PRICE IN (match.invoicePrice: as printed, its own uom and pack; bottle/1 when unstated), never with the unit the invoice COUNTS in. Before fix/receive-price-as-printed it took bottles.units.invoice, so a per-bottle price on an invoice counting cases of 12 was divided by 12 again by normalizeUnitPrice. procurement_orders.invoice_unit_price and the price_history fallback are written per bottle (match.invoicePrice.perBottle). Proven by own-paper-sighting.spec.ts ('the sighting records the invoice price in its own unit, once').
verify: grep -qF 'unitLabel: match.invoicePrice?.uom ?? null,' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/procurement.service.ts && grep -qF 'packSize: match.invoicePrice?.packSize ?? null,' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/procurement.service.ts && ! grep -qF 'unitLabel: bottles?.units.invoice.uom' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/procurement.service.ts && grep -qF 'invoice_unit_price: match.invoicePrice?.perBottle ?? null,' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/procurement.service.ts

claim: Both receiving forms carry a unit pick beside the invoice price, starting at the order line's own price unit (ADR 0119), and send it as invoicePriceUom/invoicePricePackSize when it is a pack: web ReceivingWorkspace (agreed figure shown in the picked unit with a per-bottle hint; the whole-pack mode no longer compares the typed figure against the raw header) and mobile cellar/receive/[orderId].tsx. Proven by ReceivingWorkspace.test.tsx ('the invoice price in the unit it is printed in'), the web parity cases in lib/invoiceMatch.test.ts and apps/mobile/src/lib/__tests__/invoiceMatch.test.ts.
verify: grep -qF '...priceUnitFields,' apps/web/src/pages/inventory/command/ReceivingWorkspace.tsx && grep -qF 'Math.round(agreedInPick * 100) !== Math.round(invoiceUnitPrice * 100)' apps/web/src/pages/inventory/command/ReceivingWorkspace.tsx && grep -qF '...priceUnitFields,' 'apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/cellar/receive/[orderId].tsx' && grep -qF 'priceEquals(agreedInPrintedUnit as number, asPrinted as number)' apps/mobile/src/lib/invoiceMatch.ts
